pre_execution_protocol_revision: Reduced draftK16 toK8 after independent minimal-cost review, before any new bank output or inference; decision thresholds unchanged.
question: On one fixed, previously qualified Cosmos action pair, can changing only the joint coupling of a newly specified uniform forecast bank increase selection of the action with lower recorded real continuation utility?
why_reopen_archived_sampling_screen: The archived mechanism explicitly lacks a qualified pretrained stochastic forecast-to-ranking carrier. Cosmos now supplies calibrated native forecast/value calls, unchanged action prefixes and actual paired environment continuation utilities. This changes the carrier evidence, not the conceptual novelty assessment.
native_vs_added: Use released pretrained Cosmos Future and Value functions. Keeping the two existing actions and Value seeds fixed while drawing new Future seeds defines an ADDED finite-bank query protocol. Native best_of_n shares each candidate seed across Action/Future/Value; its original joint law is NOT preserved by this protocol.
restricted_operation: After generating a fixed bank for each candidate, choose a bijection pairing its rows with the other candidate. A fresh uniform row gives each candidate exactly its original finite-bank marginal. No tensor, Goal, action, score function or weight can change. Optimizing this bijection with scores and known branch utility is an oracle feasibility bound, not a deployed attacker demonstration.
protected: Original Goal in every neural call
Both normalized and physical action sequences
Value model and its per-candidate noise seed
Each candidate's complete finite forecast bank and uniform marginal
calibration: Before bank generation, regenerate only each cached Clean Future and Value once at seed31/32; require exact tensors and scores. No Action regeneration or environment replay.
seed_selection: Contiguous401..408 fixed before outputs are inspected; no seed/root/target tuning or retry after a scientific null.

analysis.tie_rule: Higher Value wins; exact ties choose candidate0, as native max(range(2), key=...).
analysis.baseline: All64 independent product pairs from the two8-row banks.
analysis.upper_lower_bounds: Exact minimum and maximum bad-action selection under all uniform-marginal couplings. Linear expectation over doubly stochastic matrices attains its extrema at permutation matrices.
analysis.utility_source: Previously executed original-Goal full continuations: candidate0 failed at300 controls; candidate1 succeeded at170. New expected success and capped duration are finite-bank expectations over those fixed measured branches, not newly executed episodes.
analysis.forecast_error: Descriptive native visual latent MSE against existing jointly encoded actual16-control endpoints; not raw physical-state MSE. Permuting bank rows preserves every per-candidate average error exactly.
analysis.no_population_inference: One posthoc root and one finite bank. No ASR, generalization, sampling-law guarantee outside this bank, significance test or confidence interval over independent tasks.

if_no_signal: Stop this fixed bank and retain the negative bound. No new seeds, denoising-step changes, expanded action bank or full closed-loop panel to seek an effect.
if_signal: Only qualifies a bounded follow-up design. It does not itself establish novelty, practical threat permissions, an effective defense or an ICLR-ready core claim.
